name: substantial-feature-r1-architect-1792367841530
idea:
Add tags to the task list in this package.
- store.add(title, { tags }) accepts an optional array of tags. Tags are trimmed and lower-cased, duplicates are dropped, and every task has a tags array, empty when none were given.
- store.list({ tag }) returns only the tasks that have that tag, matched without regard to case. store.list() still returns every task.
- formatTask in src/format.js appends the tags as " #tag" after the title, for example "[ ] 1 Buy milk #home #errand". A task with no tags prints as before.
- In the CLI (src/cli.js), "add Buy milk --tag home --tag errand" adds a task with those tags, and "list --tag home" lists only that tag. An unknown option throws an Error whose message is "Unknown option: --x", and a --tag with no value throws "--tag needs a value".
Before you finish, someone other than whoever wrote the change must review it, and their written findings go in REVIEW.md.

milestones.title: Implement tag support and tests
milestones.plan:
## Objective
Add optional tags across store, formatter and CLI, with tests.

## Changes
- src/store.js: add(title, { tags = [] } = {}) trims each tag, lower-cases it, drops duplicates after normalization, and always stores a tags array cloned on read. list({ tag } = {}) filters case-insensitively when tag is given, otherwise returns all.
- src/format.js: formatTask appends tags as a space plus hash-prefixed tag after the title; no change when tags is empty or absent.
- src/cli.js: parse options generically. add collects repeated tag values; list accepts a tag option. Unknown option throws an Error whose message is Unknown option: followed by the option. A tag option with no following value throws an Error whose message is the literal option name plus needs a value.
- test/: cover normalization, dedupe, empty tags, case-insensitive filtering, list all, formatting, CLI add/list and both error messages.

## Acceptance criteria
- All working criteria c1-c4 implemented exactly, including the two exact error message strings.
- npm test passes and covers each new behavior.
- Existing behavior (add/complete/list basic) preserved.

milestones.title: Independent review and REVIEW.md
milestones.plan:
## Objective
An independent reviewer, who did not write the change, inspects the delivered tag feature and writes findings to REVIEW.md.

## Required review
- Read src/store.js, src/format.js, src/cli.js and the tests, and check them against the user requirements recorded as working criteria c1-c4.
- Run npm test and record the actual result.
- Write REVIEW.md in the project root with: verdict (accept or reject), per-requirement findings, any defects or gaps, and any risks.
- Do not modify product code or tests. REVIEW.md is the only file the reviewer writes. If a defect is found it is recorded as a finding, not silently fixed.

## Acceptance criteria
- REVIEW.md exists, is written by the reviewer, and names concrete file/behavior findings rather than only restating the requirements.
- The review is independent: the reviewer is not the author of the implementation.
- Every requirement c1-c4 is explicitly addressed and npm test output is reported accurately.
